speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis (Painful Bladder Syndrome)

The symptoms you described—a chronic 5-month history of bladder pain relieved by voiding, significant frequency, and dyspareunia, despite a lack of response to NSAIDs—are highly characteristic of interstitial cystitis rather than a simple urinary tract infection.
